toast.openFailed: {{profile}} could not be opened for editing

empty.title: No profiles yet
empty.body: Create your first profile with New profile in the toolbar.

delete.title: Delete “{{profile}}”?
delete.active: This profile is active on the device. Its actions, workflows and projects are deleted and the device shows no layout until another profile is activated. Its layouts are kept: they stay in Layouts, used by no profile unless another profile uses them too.
delete.inactive: Its actions, workflows and projects are deleted. This cannot be undone. Its layouts are kept: they stay in Layouts, used by no profile unless another profile uses them too.

form.duplicateDescription: The copy gets its own actions, workflows and projects, and independent copies of its layouts. Changing one profile never changes the other.
form.name: Name

detail.noneActive: Not active; no profile is active
detail.layoutsShared: Layouts are shared: this profile refers to them, and other profiles can use the same ones.

savedActions.title: Saved actions
savedActions.empty: This profile has no saved actions.
savedActions.noneUnused: Every saved action is in use.
savedActions.name: Name

gone.title: This plugin view is not available
gone.body: Its plugin was disabled or uninstalled, or no longer offers it.

variables.title: Variables of {{plugin}}
variables.description: Live values the plugin publishes under {{namespace}}. Insert one in an action or a key label with {{reference}}.

settings.title: Settings of {{plugin}}
settings.description: Stored by the agent for this plugin only. Also in Settings › Extensions › Plugins.

shell.unsavedWarning: Save or revert the current layout first

page.title: Projects
page.description: Projects of this profile and their resources on this machine

switcher.inactiveProfile: Projects can be switched for the profile that is active on the device.
switcher.title: Project switcher
switcher.description: Switching only changes which project actions refer to. Nothing is checked out, restarted or launched.
switcher.inactiveWithProject: {{profile}} is not active on the device. Its active project is {{key}}; it is restored when the profile is activated.
switcher.inactiveNoProject: {{profile}} is not active on the device. Its active project is not set; it is restored when the profile is activated.

cycle.title: Cycle order
cycle.description: {{projects}} in the cycle. Drag to reorder. Next and previous project follow this order.
cycle.descriptionEmpty: Drag to reorder. Next and previous project follow this order.
cycle.emptyHint: Projects give actions a context, such as the repository of the active project.

default.label: Default project
default.description: Selected when the profile is activated and no project was chosen before.
default.saveFailed: The default project was not saved

item.deleteDescription: Actions that refer to its resources through the active project will no longer resolve while no project provides them.

copy.title: Copy {{key}} to another profile
copy.description: The other profile gets its own copy with the same key, name and resource roles. Later changes to either project do not affect the other.

form.incompleteResource: Each resource needs a role and a resource key.
form.description: Resources map a role (for example <role>repository</role>) to a logical key such as <key>shop.repository</key>. Each machine maps keys to real paths.
form.name: Name

machine.description: These mappings are never part of a profile.
machine.empty: No resources used or mapped yet
machine.removeDescription: Actions using this resource cannot resolve it on this machine until it is mapped again.
machine.removeFailed: The mapping for {{key}} was not removed
machine.moved: This computer's resource bindings are in Settings.

binding.browseFailed: The file browser did not open
binding.saveFailed: The mapping for {{key}} was not saved

repositories.title: Repositories
repositories.description: Each repository's folder is set on this computer only and is never exported. The default repository is the one actions use through the repository role.
repositories.empty: No repositories yet. Add one by choosing its folder.
repositories.pickFailed: The folder could not be chosen
repositories.removeDescription: Only the entry is removed. Its folder stays set on this computer (Settings › Resources) and nothing on disk is touched.
repositories.usesRole: The repository role of this project points at its folder and keeps pointing there.
repositories.name: Repository name
repositories.invalidKey: Use a lowercase letter, then up to 31 lowercase letters, digits or _.
repositories.duplicateKey: The key “{{key}}” is already used in this project.
repositories.boundOnSave: This folder is set on this computer when you save.
repositories.roleFollows: Actions that use the repository role will use {{name}}.
repositories.roleStays: The repository role still points at the removed repository's folder.
repositories.bindFailed: The project was saved, but a folder was not set on this computer
repositories.lastWithRole: Remove the repository role first to remove the last repository.

workSession.checkAgent: Check that the agent is running in Settings › Agent.
workSession.unlockNext: Unlock DeckPilot if it is locked, then try again.
workSession.loadFailed: The work session could not be loaded

idle.label: No work session
idle.hint: Click the Work Session key to start one.

starting.label: Starting…
starting.hint: The start workflow is running. Time counts once it succeeds. Hold the key to cancel.

working.label: Working
working.hint: To finish, click the key to run the end check. Without a verification workflow, hold the key instead.

verifyingEnd.label: Checking…
verifyingEnd.hint: The verification workflow is running; the timer keeps going. Hold the key to cancel the check.

readyToFinish.label: Ready to finish
readyToFinish.hint: Click the key to finish and stop the timer. Hold it to keep working.

stopping.label: Stopping…
stopping.hint: The session is being closed. The stop time is already fixed.

startFailed.title: The work session did not start
startFailed.next: Check the start workflow's run in its history, then click the key to start again.

startInterrupted.title: Starting the work session was interrupted
startInterrupted.next: The start workflow may have run partly. Click the key to start again.

verificationFailed.title: The end check failed
verificationFailed.next: The timer keeps running. Check the verification workflow's run, then check again from the key.

verificationInterrupted.title: The end check was interrupted
verificationInterrupted.next: The timer keeps running. Check again from the key.

notReady.title: Not ready to finish yet
notReady.next: The verification workflow answered no. The timer keeps running.

approvalExpired.title: The approval to finish expired
approvalExpired.next: Run the end check again from the key, then click it to finish.

approvalInvalidated.title: The approval to finish was withdrawn
approvalInvalidated.next: Run the end check again from the key, then click it to finish.

needsReview.title: A gap in the session needs review
needsReview.next: It is counted. Exclude it in the session history if you did not work then.

verificationIssue.missingCanFinish: Has no output “canFinish”. Add a Boolean output named canFinish.
verificationIssue.canFinishNotBoolean: Its output “canFinish” is not a Boolean. Change its kind to Boolean.
verificationIssue.detailsNotText: Its output “details” is not text. Change its kind to Text.

issues.unfilledInputs_one: Needs the input {{names}}, which a work session cannot give. Give it a default or make it optional.
issues.unfilledInputs_other: Needs the inputs {{names}}, which a work session cannot give. Give them a default or make them optional.
issues.missingWorkflow: This workflow no longer exists. Choose another one or none.

history.title: History
history.description: Sessions kept on this computer, newest first. Gaps longer than the review threshold are counted and flagged; exclude one if you did not work then.
history.loadFailed: The session history could not be loaded
history.emptyHint: Sessions appear here once the Work Session key has started one.
history.noIntervals: None: the timer never started (the start workflow did not succeed).

status.title: Current session
status.description: Operated from its key on the device; this page only shows the state.

page.title: Work Session
page.description: Time worked, started and finished from a key on the device
page.unsupportedTitle: Work sessions need a newer agent
page.unsupportedDescription: The running agent does not support work sessions. Restart the agent in Settings › Agent so the one installed with this app runs.

key.title: Work Session key
key.description: Any key can control the work session; no action is created for it.
key.step1: Open the Layout Designer and select a key.
key.step2: In its gestures, choose Changes with state and then Work Session.
key.step3: The key then shows the state and the elapsed time. Click it to start; when working, click it to run the end check, or hold it if no verification workflow is set; click it again when it shows Finish Work.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: For sessions started while this profile is active. Saving withdraws an approval to finish, so a session that is ready to finish needs a new end check.
settings.loadFailed: The work session settings could not be loaded
settings.saveFailed: The work session settings were not saved

start.label: Start workflow
start.hint: Runs when the key starts a session; time counts once it succeeds. If it fails, the session does not start.

verification.label: End verification workflow
verification.hint: Must output canFinish (Boolean): true allows finishing, false keeps the session running. An optional text output details is shown with the result. Without one, holding the key in a running session makes it ready to finish at once.

settings.unusable: Workflows that cannot verify the end

approval.label: Approval lasts (minutes)
approval.hint: How long a passed end check allows finishing.

reviewGap.label: Flag gaps longer than (minutes)
reviewGap.hint: Longer gaps (sleep, agent not running) are counted and flagged in the history.

gestures.title: Gesture timings
gestures.description: How long a long press or a double click takes is set on the key, in the Layout Designer's gesture editor. Keys without their own timings use the defaults in Settings › Devices.

credentials.loadFailed: The credentials could not be loaded
credentials.loadNext: Unlock DeckPilot and reopen this page
credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Tokens and passwords that requests use by their name. They are stored encrypted on this computer only: never in a workflow, never in an export, and never shown again after saving.
credentials.deleteDescription: Requests that use it will fail until a credential with this name is stored again.
credentials.name: Name
credentials.nameInvalid: Lower case letters, digits, “.”, “_” and “-”, starting with a letter.
credentials.nameTaken: A credential with this name exists; saving replaces it.
credentials.nameHint: What actions refer to, e.g. in an HTTP request's Credential field.
credentials.secretHint: A token, or user:password for basic authentication.
